name: ormeggio
description: Come back after days away and find every session where you left it: the stalled ones resumed, the open questions in one place.

plugins.name: ormeggio
plugins.description: A hook that notices a long absence from your own rhythm, and a skill that resumes the sessions that stalled on a usage limit, an expired login, a restart or a tool left halfway, a dozen at a time after a memory check, with every open question gathered in one place.
